name: Fonta: Passionate Red
description:
"Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment!"
Specially flavored Fonta, said to use Henna Berries from Sumeru as an ingredient. When used as the theme for a Card Back, even your opponent will be able to feel your passion.
It's said that Henna Berries from the deserts of Sumeru can't lie, because if they did, they'd be "read" straight through.
